# Broadcasts

Create, update, and delete live streams; manage stream sources, tokens, recording, and subscribers.

Part of the [API Catalog](./). Full schemas: [Swagger](https://antmedia.io/rest/).

## Conventions

| Placeholder | Meaning |
|-------------|---------|
| `{domain}` | Server hostname or IP |
| `{app}` | Application name (often `live`) |
| Path/query placeholders | Match the parameter name in the tables below |

Use port `5080` with `http://` for local HTTP tests.

**Base URL:** `https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/...`

**Auth:** [IP filter](/guides/developer-sdk-and-api/rest-api-guide/securing-rest-apis/) or `-H "Authorization: Bearer {JWTToken}"` — see [Secure with JWT](/guides/developer-sdk-and-api/rest-api-guide/jwt-rest-api-filter/).

:::tip Windows Command Prompt
Escape JSON quotes in `-d` bodies: `-d "{""name"":""My Stream""}"`
:::

## `deleteBroadcastsBulk`

[deleteBroadcastsBulk](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/deleteBroadcastsBulk) — Delete multiple broadcasts from data store and stop if they are broadcasting

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `DELETE` | `/rest/v2/broadcasts` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | query | yes | Comma-separated stream Ids |

```bash
curl -X DELETE \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts?ids={ids}"
```

## `deleteBroadcast`

[Delete broadcast from data store and stop if it's broadcasting](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/deleteBroadcast)

## `updateBroadcast`

[updateBroadcast](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/updateBroadcast) — Updates the Broadcast objects fields if it's not null. The updated fields are as follows: name, description, userName, password, IP address, streamUrl of the broadcast. It also updates the social endpoints

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `PUT` | `/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `id` | path | yes | Broadcast id |

Request body: Broadcast object with the updates. See schema in [Swagger](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/updateBroadcast).

```bash
curl -X PUT \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}" \
  -d '{}'
```

## `getActiveSubtracksCount`

```bash
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/active-subtracks-count?role={role}"
```

## `getActiveSubtracks`

[Get active subtracks of a broadcast](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/getActiveSubtracks) — Returns the list of active subtracks associated with a main broadcast. Only returns subtracks that are currently broadcasting.

| `size` | path | yes | Number of items that will be fetched. If there is not enough active subtracks, returned list size may be less than this… |

```bash
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/active-subtracks/{offset}/{size}?role={role}"
```

## `removeEndpoint`

[Removes a third party RTMP or SRT end point from the stream](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/removeEndpoint) — It supports removing RTMP or SRT restreaming endpoints after broadcast is started. Resolution can be specified if endpoint is added with resolution. If an URL is not added to a stream, trying to remove that Endpoint URL will return false.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `DELETE` | `/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/endpoint` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `id` | path | yes | Broadcast id |
| `endpointServiceId` | query | yes | RTMP or SRT URL of the target endpoint that should be stopped |
| `resolutionHeight` | query | no | Resolution specifier if endpoint has been added with resolution. Only applicable if user added RTMP or SRT endpoint wit… |

```bash
curl -X DELETE \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/endpoint?endpointServiceId={endpointServiceId}&resolutionHeight={resolutionHeight}"
```

## `addEndpoint`

[Adds a third party RTMP or SRT end point to the stream](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/addEndpoint) — It supports adding RTMP or SRT restreaming endpoints after broadcast is started. Resolution can be specified to send a specific adaptive resolution. If an URL is already added to a stream, trying to add the same Endpoint URL will return false.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `POST` | `/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/endpoint` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `id` | path | yes | Broadcast id |
| `resolutionHeight` | query | no | Resolution height of the broadcast that is wanted to send to the endpoint. |

Request body: SRT or RTMP URL of the destination endpoint where the stream will be republished. Encode the URL if required. See schema in [Swagger](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/addEndpoint).

```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/endpoint?resolutionHeight={resolutionHeight}" \
  -d '{}'
```

## `moveIPCamera`

[Move IP Camera](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/moveIPCamera) — Supports continuous, relative, and absolute movement. By default, it's a relative move. Movement parameters should be provided according to the movement type. Generally, the following values are used: For Absolute move, value X and value Y are between -1.0f and 1.0f. Zoom value…

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `POST` | `/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/ip-camera/move` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `id` | path | yes | The id of the IP Camera |
| `valueX` | query | no | Movement in X direction. If not specified, it's assumed to be zero. Valid ranges between -1.0f and 1.0f for all movemen… |
| `valueY` | query | no | Movement in Y direction. If not specified, it's assumed to be zero. Valid ranges between -1.0f and 1.0f for all movemen… |
| `valueZ` | query | no | Movement in Zoom. If not specified, it's assumed to be zero. Valid ranges for relative and continous move is between -1… |
| `movement` | query | no | Movement type. It can be absolute, relative or continuous. If not specified, it's relative |

```bash
curl -X POST \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/ip-camera/move?valueX={valueX}&valueY={valueY}&valueZ={valueZ}&movement={movement}"
```

## `getJwtTokenV2`

[getJwtTokenV2](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/getJwtTokenV2) — Generates JWT token for specified stream. It's not required to let the server generate JWT. Generally JWT tokens should be generated on the client side.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `GET` | `/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/jwt-token` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `id` | path | yes | The id of the stream |
| `expireDate` | query | yes | The expire time of the token. It's in unix timestamp seconds. |
| `type` | query | yes | Type of the JWT token. It may be play or publish |
| `roomId` | query | no | Room Id that token belongs to. It's not mandatory |

```bash
curl -X GET \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/jwt-token?expireDate={expireDate}&type={type}&roomId={roomId}"
```

## `enableRecording`

[Set stream specific recording setting](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/enableRecording) — This setting overrides the general Mp4 and WebM Muxing Setting for a specific stream.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `PUT` | `/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/recording/{recording-status}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `id` | path | yes | the id of the stream |
| `recording-status` | path | yes | Change recording status. If true, starts recording. If false stop recording |
| `recordType` | query | no | Record type: 'mp4' or 'webm'. It's optional parameter. |
| `resolutionHeight` | query | no | Resolution height of the broadcast that is wanted to record. |
| `fileName` | query | no | Optional base filename (without extension) for the output VOD. |

```bash
curl -X PUT \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/recording/{recording-status}?recordType={recordType}&resolutionHeight={resolutionHeight}&fileName={fileName}"
```

| `type` | path | yes | block type it can be 'publish', 'play' or 'publish_play' |

```bash
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/broadcasts/{id}/subscribers/{sid}/block/{seconds}/{type}"
```

|-----------|----|----------|-------------|

| `sort_by` | query | no | Field to sort. Possible values are "name", "date", "status" |
